name: IrrigationSchedulePlanner
tagline: Irrigate the right block, at the right time, within your water consent.
description: A complete irrigation scheduling app for Power Apps and Power Pages: soil-water deficit and refill-point alerts per block from probe readings and ET₀ × Kc, a week calendar by pump set with clash and capacity checks, water licence allocation vs use and commitment, a status workflow from planned to completed with reasons and an event log – working with demo data the moment it is dropped on a screen.
features: Soil-water bucket model per block (deficit, refill point, days to refill, recommended depth and run time)
Week calendar by pump set with overnight runs, clashes and pump-hour limits
Water licence allocation, used, committed, monthly use and end-of-year projection
Pump capacity and clash rules with override reasons
Status workflow with rules: schedule, start (operator, pump busy), complete (applied depth, deviation reason), skip (reason, rain), cancel
Bulk reschedule, assign pump, schedule, skip, cancel with per-event skip list
CSV export and 7-day ScheduleJson for flows and e-mails
Undo, keyboard shortcuts, ARIA, phone bottom bar and agenda
